slides.title: A letter that sparkles
slides.text: A letter lands in the Netville post with big, exciting words. Pim reads it slowly. Exciting does not always mean true, says Pim.
slides.alt: Spot the Trick opens its first message card: friendly words on the surface, and clues hiding in the text.

focus.cue: The first letter: big, exciting words
Tap every cue that smells like a trick

slides.title: Clues one and two
slides.text: Clue one is a rush: reply in ten minutes or lose it! Clue two is a prize for a contest you never entered.
slides.alt: Checking the message: the first clue is marked, and the card still has more of its tricks to find.

focus.cue: Clue one, found: hurry, only ten minutes
The letter itself begs: reply in the next ten minutes

slides.title: Clues three and four
slides.text: Clue three: it comes from someone you do not know. Clue four asks for your key. Real companies and real games never ask for your passphrase.
slides.alt: A trick card from the Game Shop, a sender nobody knows: free coins today only, tap the button to claim them.

focus.cue: Free coins today only, from the Game Shop
Its cues: free coins, hurry, a button begging a tap

slides.title: Count the clues
slides.text: Pim reads one more letter out loud. Count the clues hiding inside its friendly words before Pim decides.
steps: A prize you never entered for
A sender you do not know
slides.alt: A second message card to judge: is it a trick with clues, or a safe message with none?

focus.cue: One more letter: your account is locked
Count its clues: threats, key asks, unknown sender

slides.title: What to do
slides.text: When you spot a trick, do not reply and do not tap anything. Show it to a trusted adult. A trick that fishes for secrets is called phishing.
slides.alt: A third trick card: the safe move is always the same — stop, do not reply, and tell a trusted adult.

focus.cue: Not every message is a trick: read carefully first
A real one: a field trip note from your teacher

words.means: a message that tries to fool you
a trick message that fishes for your secrets
a hint that something is not what it seems
something you win in a game or a draw

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Packet Post at Spot the Trick and check 4 cards. Tap every clue you find, then decide if each card is a trick or safe.
slides.alt: Spot the Trick opens its first message card: friendly words on the surface, and clues hiding in the text.
